title: Student Life
description: Progressive Web App organizing academic schedules, coursework tracking, and productivity tools.

caseStudy.tagline: All-in-one offline-first academic productivity ecosystem consolidating schedules, tasks, and focus sessions.

problem.headline: Consolidating fragmented student productivity tools into a single offline-ready hub.
problem.description: Students frequently juggle assignments, course schedules, and Pomodoro timers across three or four separate disconnected applications. Unreliable campus Wi-Fi often leads to lost edits or out-of-sync schedules.

architecture.headline: Progressive Web App with optimistic local-first state synchronization.
architecture.description: Designed an offline-first architecture utilizing IndexedDB for instantaneous local reads and writes, paired with Supabase for cloud persistence. When connection drops, state changes queue locally in IndexedDB and reconcile with Supabase on reconnect.

highlights.title: Optimistic State Architecture
highlights.detail: Immediate UI updates for task completions and schedule shifts with background Supabase mutation queues.

highlights.title: Dedicated Worker Focus Timer
highlights.detail: Web Worker-backed Pomodoro cycle preventing background tab throttling and maintaining precision timing.

highlights.title: Academic Schedule Matrix
highlights.detail: Conflict-detecting schedule calendar with automated reminders and priority weighting.

features.title: Smart Coursework Manager
features.description: Kanban and list views with due-date countdowns and priority tags.

features.title: Precision Pomodoro Timer
features.description: Customizable work/break cycles running on dedicated Web Workers.

features.title: Offline PWA Support
features.description: Installable on desktop and mobile with full offline functionality and automatic sync.

takeaways: Building for students means designing for imperfect network conditions: optimistic local-first storage transforms the UX from fragile to dependable.
Web Workers are critical for web timers to avoid browser background tab sleep throttling.
